    r0=min(i for i,j in pos); r1=max(i for i,j in pos); c0=min(j for i,j in pos); c1=max(j for i,j in pos)
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    # pattern cells: non-zero, outside the frame rectangle bounds (the frame is a hollow rect drawn somewhere; pattern sits elsewhere)
    pat=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0 and not(r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1)]
    ph=max(i for i,j,v in pat)-min(i for i,j,v in pat)+1
    pw=max(j for i,j,v in pat)-min(j for i,j,v in pat)+1
    p=[[g[min(i for i,j,v in pat)+a][min(j for i,j,v in pat)+b] for b in range(pw)] for a in range(ph)]
    ky,kx=ih//ph,iw//pw
    O=[[frame]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    for a in range(ih):
        for b in range(iw):
            O[a+1][b+1]=p[a//ky][b//kx]
    return O
